prompt: Why should staff avoid joining two shorter lengths?
promptZh: 為何不能把兩段較短的卷材接起來？

options.whyZh: 背膠種類不因接縫而改變。

options.text: The seam would run across part of the lettering.
options.whyZh: 工單明說接縫會穿過一個詞，不可拼接。

options.text: The roll would become narrower than the panel.
options.whyZh: 接長度不改變卷材寬度，限制在文字中間的接縫。

options.text: The added material belongs on a different sign.
options.zh: 新增材料是另一個標誌用的。
options.whyZh: 新增的材料要放在同一版面。

explanationZh: 工單明說接縫會穿過一個詞，不可拼接。
evidence: Prepare the full length from a single roll: a join would cross the middle of a word.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: Prepare the full length from a single roll: a join would cross the middle of a word.

vocabulary.note: 將兩段貼膜接在一起時留下的接合處。
